title: Gujarat to Get Asia’s First Desert-Themed Night Safari

blocks.content: Gujarat has received approval for the Desert Zoological Park and Night Safari at Juna Deesa in Banaskantha district. The project will be developed on about 103 hectares of contiguous government land and is planned as Asia’s first desert-themed drive-through night safari.

items: The Central Zoo Authority is the statutory body that regulates zoos in India under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
Banaskantha district is located in northern Gujarat and shares a border with Rajasthan.
Chinkara, blackbuck, and Indian wild ass are protected Indian mammals associated with arid and semi-arid habitats.
Night safari facilities are designed to allow observation of nocturnal animals under controlled lighting and visitor movement.
